title: Existence of the ordered global twist line
statement: Construct the global line isomorphism by gluing normalized local chart isomorphisms and their inverses.

proof.text: For all pairs (V,i) consisting of an affine base open and an ordered coordinate, use the affine frame theorem on U_(V,i)=p^{-1}(V)∩f^{-1}(D_+(X_i)). These opens cover. The pulled standard sections and the adjoint quotient sections are free frames there and have the same coordinate ratios. On each subopen of an overlap, expressing the i-frame as its coordinate ratio times the j-frame and cancelling the free j-frame transports every linear relation from the standard line to D.line. Scheme.Modules.isoOfIsFreeGenerator glues the uniquely determined frame maps to an isomorphism of ordinary pullbacks. Compose with boundaryPullbackComparison to obtain the required tensor-pullback isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ordered_twist_line (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (r : ℕ) (b : RelativeProjectiveSpace.freeModule S r ≅ E)
    (eRel : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj ≅
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r)
    (hRel : eRel.hom ≫ RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r =
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)
    (hAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens,
      ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V)
    (θ : RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r ≅ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S))
    (hθ : θ.hom ≫ (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S) ↘ S) =
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r)
    (hθAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens, RelativeProjectiveSpace.IsIntegralProjComparison
      S r V (RelativeProjectiveSpace.affineToIntegral S r θ V)) :
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).obj
        (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) S 1) ≅ D.line, True
